name: io.github.JJordPy/health-evidence
title: Health Evidence & Supplement Safety
description: How much research backs a health claim (PubMed, trials) plus FDA supplement safety. Pay per call.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool on this server with its price in USDC and what it returns. Health research evidence from PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA safety signals (adverse event reports, recalls) and official NIH supplement fact sheets. Not medical advice.

tools.name: health_claim_report
tools.description: All-in-one health claim check for AI agents. Send a topic (e.g. ashwagandha) and optional outcome (e.g. anxiety) and get the research evidence from PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov (study counts by type, research-volume level, key studies) plus FDA safety signals (adverse event reports, reactions, recalls) and the official NIH fact sheet where one exists, with plain-English highlights, as JSON. Primary sources, not news. Cheaper than separate calls. Not medical advice. Errors never charged. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

topic.description: Treatment, food or supplement, e.g. ashwagandha. Example: ashwagandha

outcome.description: Health outcome or condition, e.g. anxiety (optional). Example: anxiety

tools.name: health_evidence_check
tools.description: Pay-per-call health evidence check for AI agents. Send a topic (e.g. green tea) and optional outcome (e.g. blood pressure) and get counts of PubMed studies by type (human, randomised trials, systematic reviews, animal-only), registered clinical trials, a research-volume level and links to key reviews and trials, as JSON. Primary sources, not news. Shows how much research exists, not whether it works. Not medical advice. Errors never charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

topic.description: Treatment, food, supplement or exposure, e.g. green tea. Example: green tea

outcome.description: Health outcome or condition, e.g. blood pressure (optional). Example: blood pressure

tools.name: nih_supplement_factsheet
tools.description: Pay-per-call official NIH fact sheet for AI agents. Send a vitamin, mineral, supplement or health topic (e.g. vitamin D, magnesium, omega-3, insomnia) and get plain-English sections on what it is, what the science says, possible harms and interactions, with a link, as JSON. From NIH ODS, with NIH MedlinePlus as backup. Dose content left out. Public domain. Not medical advice. Errors never charged. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

name.description: Vitamin, mineral or supplement, e.g. vitamin D. Example: vitamin d

tools.name: supplement_safety_signals
tools.description: Pay-per-call FDA safety signals for AI agents. Send a supplement or food ingredient (e.g. ashwagandha, kratom, green tea extract) and get the number of FDA adverse event reports for products named with it, the most reported reactions and outcomes, and recent recalls with class and reason, as JSON. Hard for agents to gather from FDA's raw databases. Reports do not prove causation. Public domain openFDA data. Not medical advice. Errors never charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

name.description: Supplement or food ingredient, e.g. ashwagandha. Example: ashwagandha
